hooks.command: input=$(cat); [ -n "$CC_STOP_HOOK_INNER" ] && exit 0; sid=$(jq -r .session_id <<<"$input"); last=$(jq -r '.last_assistant_message // ""' <<<"$input"); f=$(grep -l "$sid" ~/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); name=unnamed; tmuxloc=""; if [ -n "$f" ]; then name=$(jq -r '.name // "unnamed"' "$f"); tmuxloc=$(jq -r '.tmux // ""' "$f"); fi; if [ -n "$tmuxloc" ]; then t=${tmuxloc#*:}; win=${t%.*}; ( for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do tmux set-option -w -t "$win" window-status-style 'bg=red,fg=white,bold'; tmux set-option -w -t "$win" window-status-current-style 'bg=red,fg=white,bold'; sleep 0.25; tmux set-option -w -u -t "$win" window-status-style; tmux set-option -w -u -t "$win" window-status-current-style; sleep 0.25; done ) & fi; doing=$(CC_STOP_HOOK_INNER=1 claude -p --model haiku "Output only a gerund phrase of at most 6 words, no punctuation, describing the task just completed, based on this final assistant message: ${last:0:1500}"); afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Hero.aiff; say "Claude code is done with ${doing:-the task} in session ${name//-/ }"
